{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/node/mempool_args.cpp and test/functional/mempool_cluster.py to validate cluster limits and reject invalid negations.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents an assertion crash in TxGraph caused by -nolimitclustercount when mempool sanity checks are enabled, and prevents transactions from failing with misleading errors on -limitclustersize=0. These startup validation fixes address edge-case configuration bugs without altering core transaction relay or eviction policies."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/bitcoin-cli.cpp only to adjust boolean flag evaluation for command-line arguments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The minor edit in bitcoin-cli.cpp follows from node-wide argument parsing changes and does not alter JSON-RPC interfaces, commands, or authentication machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies shared argument parsing and startup code in src/common/args.cpp, src/common/args.h, and src/init.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes counterintuitive and hazardous behaviors when options are negated across the node, such as executing binaries named '0', setting RPC passwords to '0', and writing block files to the working directory. It introduces NEGATE_TO_DEFAULT in args.cpp to establish robust semantics for options that are disabled by default."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/wallet/init.cpp, src/wallet/load.cpp, and src/wallet/walletutil.cpp to handle empty -walletdir paths.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The edits in src/wallet/ merely follow from the updated argument handling by treating empty directory paths as unset, without affecting wallet functionality or fund safety."
    }
  ],
